title: Social Change Career Podcast (Craig Zelizer, PCDN.Global) — 'a blueprint for organizations that can grow, prosper, and endure without losing their soul'
summary: Zelizer founded PCDN.Global, a career hub for people working in social impact, and interviews impact professionals on its Social Change Career Podcast. Eric was the guest, on how ownership and governance reshape behavior as an organization grows.
blockquote: Drawing on two decades of work with founders, CEOs, and investors, Eric exposes the forces that make companies vulnerable to short-term thinking — and offers a blueprint for organizations that can grow, prosper, and endure without losing their soul.
blockquote_source: Social Change Career Podcast episode page (PCDN.Global)
attribution_title: Podcast hosted by Craig Zelizer — founder of PCDN.Global, social entrepreneur
